notes: Automatic AOs now site FOBs in moderate-risk ground rather than the red zones, and every FOB keeps at least one company home instead of sending everyone on patrol
Threatened FOBs (heavy local danger, recent attacks, or a Republican Guard division within about 150 km) get a second company moved in from a quieter FOB in the same AO

Under any ROE, an AO counter-attacks to take back a base the enemy captures inside it. Aggressive ROE accepts worse odds and brings artillery and air; weapons free reaches beyond the AO line. Under aggressive and weapons-free ROE, AOs also push into insurgent-held towns on their own: more ground taken back, more civilian risk
